value.rationale: The HPP four-velocity lattice gas is a foundational reversible cellular automaton; fixed microstates on its first genuine two-lane periodic channel form a natural dynamical ensemble. Exact joint population by mass and active head-on collision columns reveals a parity obstruction, an exponentially dominant collision-active phase, exact finite-size occupation-collision orthogonality, and limiting independent Gaussian noise. The precise quantities serve as a nontrivial benchmark without claiming higher-width hydrodynamics.
